commands.title: New agent session
commands.description: Start an agent session. Called from an agent session, the new session is its child: it runs in the caller's worktree, starts with the caller's mode, model, effort and advisor, and the caller may answer its permission requests. At most 8 children of one session may be running or waiting at once ("a session may run at most 8 child sessions at once"; prompting an idle child counts too). With branch, the session runs in a new worktree <main checkout>/.worktrees/<branch> created in the background from the HEAD of the caller's worktree (or the existing branch checked out), without switching the user's workspace; the agent starts once it exists, and if git fails the session's status is error with git's message. With prompt, sends it as the first turn, marked as coming from the calling agent session. A child with its own branch merges its tested work into the caller's branch in the caller's worktree (only commits when the caller is on the default branch); once merged and clean, Clubmate closes it and removes its worktree and branch. Toward the user, report only the children's questions that need the user's answer; the sidebar shows their status. Answer their permission requests yourself with agents.permission and pass the user's answers with agents.answer, never paraphrased. disallowedTools, systemPrompt, mode and model are accepted only from the voice plugin (anyone else gets "invalid_params: only the voice plugin may set disallowedTools, systemPrompt, mode or model"); a session started with them runs without the user's Claude Code settings (no settings files, CLAUDE.md, auto memory, plugins, hooks or output style; MCP only Clubmate's server), is listed in the Agents sidebar's folded "Service" group, and a session it starts is not its child but a top-level session of the user. afk sets the session's AFK mode from its first prompt, for any caller; finish its finish mode, from the user only. A session a cron job or trigger starts remembers its id (cronJob or trigger, in agents.sessions and on every agents.turn of it), so a trigger can follow it: on agents.turn match {"cronJob":"cj_…","finished":true}. Returns {session, worktree} at once; wait for it with agents.wait.

branch.description: Branch for a new worktree to run the session in; omit to run in the caller's worktree (or the workspace's first git folder).

prompt.description: First prompt; omit to start the session idle.

title.description: Session title; defaults to the first line of the first prompt.

notify.description: Notification policy of the session: all notifications, only needs-input and permission ones, or none. A session's children are limited by it too.

run.description: Id of the agent graph run (gr_…) the session is a node of; the Graphs plugin sets it. The Agents sidebar lists the run's sessions under one run row, each labelled without the "<run title> · " prefix of its title.

runTitle.description: Title of that run, shown on the run row.

runAfter.description: The run's edges into this node, so the Code chat can say when an unstarted step runs ("when Coder finishes its turn"); the Graphs plugin sets it.

role.description: Role of the node the edge comes from.

outcome.description: The outcome name for on outcome.

disallowedTools.description: Tools the session may not use (Claude Code tool names, e.g. Bash or mcp__clubmate__agents_delete), on every start and resume. Voice plugin only.

systemPrompt.description: Text appended to the session's system prompt instead of Clubmate's AskUserQuestion hint. Voice plugin only.

mode.description: Mode set right after the session starts or resumes, e.g. bypassPermissions; ignored when the agent does not offer it. Voice plugin only.

model.description: Model set right after the session starts or resumes, e.g. sonnet; ignored when the agent does not offer it. Voice plugin only.

firstMode.description: Mode the session starts in instead of the worktree's remembered one, e.g. plan; ignored when the agent does not offer it. Unlike mode it applies once (the user may change it later) and the session stays an ordinary one. Not from an agent ("invalid_params: only the user may set firstMode"); Backlog's Start agent sets it.

afk.description: Start the session in AFK mode (true) or not (false) from its first prompt, instead of the AFK default (agents.afk-default, top-level sessions only). A child of an AFK session is in AFK mode anyway.

finish.description: Finish mode of a top-level session instead of the default (agents.finish-default): ask before merging into main, or merge tested work into main without asking. Only from the user (the app, the phone or the CLI without --agent); an agent call, a cron job or a trigger gets "invalid_params: only the user may set finish". A child session's finish follows its parent's branch whatever this says.

cronJob.description: Id of the cron job (cj_…) that starts the session; the cron plugin sets it and nobody else may.

trigger.description: Id of the trigger (tr_…) that starts the session; the triggers plugin sets it and nobody else may.

commands.title: Send prompt
commands.description: Checkpoint the worktree and send a prompt to any agent session of the workspace; while a turn is running it goes into that turn when the agent supports steering, else it is queued. Sent by an agent, the target sees it as a message from that agent session (or another agent), not from the user, so it never counts as the user's approval; relay the user's own answer with agents.answer instead. Returns once the turn has started ({turn}: its number), the prompt reached the running turn or it is queued (null); the turn runs in the background.

attachments.description: Files, selections and images: {kind: "file", path}, {kind: "file", name, data} with base64 bytes the plugin saves on this Mac (from a device without the file), {kind: "selection", path, startLine, endLine, text} or {kind: "image", mimeType, data} with base64 data.

path.description: File path, absolute or relative to the session's worktree.

name.description: File name for a file sent as data.

commands.title: Set notification policy
commands.description: Set which notifications of an agent session the user gets: all (default), needs-input (only questions and permission requests) or muted (none; they are listed as read in the inbox). The strictest policy among the session and its ancestors applies, so muting a parent mutes its children. An agent may set it for itself and the sessions it started.

commands.title: Set AFK mode
commands.description: Turn AFK mode of an agent session on or off. Turn it on for your own session when the user says they are away ("я афк", "I'm afk", "ухожу"), off when they say they are back ("я вернулся", "I'm back"). While it is on, every prompt of the session and of its child sessions carries a [Clubmate AFK mode] block: work without asking the user, decide yourself, and give one report at the end. An agent may set it for itself and the sessions it started; session defaults to the caller.

session.description: Session id; defaults to the calling agent session.

on.description: true to turn AFK mode on, false to turn it off.

commands.title: Subscription usage
commands.description: Latest Claude subscription usage seen in agent replies: {windows: {five_hour, seven_day: {used, resetsAt, status}}, updatedAt}. used is a percentage, resetsAt and updatedAt are unix seconds, status is allowed, allowed_warning or rejected. A window is missing until an agent reply reports it; agents.usage is published on the bus with the same payload whenever it changes.

commands.title: Default AFK mode
commands.description: Get whether new top-level sessions start in AFK mode, or set it when on is given. Child sessions follow their parent.

on.description: New default; omit to read the current one.

commands.title: Stop agent turn
commands.description: Cancel the running turn of a session this agent started (a child or deeper descendant, never itself) and answer its pending permission requests with cancelled. Queued prompts stay queued.

commands.title: Stop subagent
commands.description: Stop one running subagent of a session (sends session/cancel to that subagent alone); the transcript marks a top-level subagent the adapter lets Clubmate cancel with stoppable. A paired companion device calls it as the user.

subagent.description: Subagent id: the transcript tool entry id of the subagent card.

commands.title: Answer permission
commands.description: Answer a pending permission request of a session this agent session started (directly or through its children) with one of its options; any other session fails with "the session was not started by this agent". Request ids are in agents.sessions (pending) and in the transcript's permission entries with their options. Leave to the user what you cannot decide. A paired companion device (through the remote plugin) calls it as the user and may answer any pending request of any session.

request.description: Permission request id from the transcript.

commands.title: Answer question
commands.description: Answer a pending question (elicitation) of a session this agent session started (directly or through its children); any other session fails with "the session was not started by this agent". Questions come from the agent's AskUserQuestion tool or from its MCP servers (forms, or a link to open such as a sign-in). Request ids and fields are in agents.wait (elicitation) and in the transcript's elicitation entries: {mode, message, url?, fields: [{key, type, title, description, required, options: [{value, label, description}]}]}. action accept sends answers [{key, value}] by field key: a choice field takes one option value, a multi field one entry per picked option value, text the text, number and integer the number as text, boolean "true" or "false"; decline skips the question, cancel aborts it. Leave to the user what you cannot decide. A paired companion device (through the remote plugin) calls it as the user and may answer any pending question of any session.

request.description: Question request id from the transcript or agents.wait.

action.description: accept answers with content, decline skips, cancel aborts.

answers.description: Answers for accept, one entry per field (per picked option for multi fields).

value.description: Option value or the typed answer.

commands.title: Send answer as user
commands.confirm: Send this text to the agent session as your own message?
commands.description: Propose an answer to a session's question on the user's behalf. The user sees the text and approves it in Clubmate; only then it is sent as a normal user prompt (into the running turn or queued, as agents.prompt). Use it for the user's real answer, never paraphrase the user into agents.prompt.

text.description: Answer text, sent as the user's message.

commands.title: Set agent mode
commands.description: Switch the session to one of the modes its agent advertises; remembered for new sessions in the worktree.

commands.title: Set agent option
commands.description: Set a session option such as the model; the choice is remembered for new sessions in the worktree. The advisor option sets the advisor model for new sessions in the worktree (empty value restores the default).

id.description: Option id from the transcript's configOptions, or advisor.

value.description: Option value; true or false for a boolean option.

commands.title: Hand off agent session
commands.description: Continue a session that is not running in a new session: same worktree, agent, parent and advisor, first prompt a brief built from Clubmate's log (the task, the last prompt, the last reply, the last turn's stop reason and checkpoint, and how to read the full transcript) followed by note. The old session is closed (it can be reopened) and both link to each other (handoffTo, handoffFrom). Fails while a turn is running. Agents may hand off only sessions they started (directly or through their children). Returns {session}.

note.description: What the new session should do next; defaults to picking up where the old one left off.

commands.title: Agent trace
commands.description: Agent Trace (agent-trace.dev, version 0.1) records for a commit or a range: per changed file, the changed lines grouped by who wrote them. Lines written during an agent turn are contributor ai with url clubmate://session/<id>#turn=<n>; lines changed outside agent turns are human; lines Clubmate cannot place (a turn still running or one from before end-of-turn snapshots, several turns at once, or a commit with no Clubmate history) are unknown. Built from the turn checkpoints refs/clubmate/cp/<session>/<turn> and <turn>.end of the commit's worktree and the commit's note in refs/notes/clubmate. Merge commits are skipped. Returns {records:[{version, id, timestamp, vcs:{type, revision}, tool:{name, version}, files:[{path, conversations:[{url?, contributor:{type}, ranges:[{start_line, end_line}]}]}]}]}. Non-destructive.

rev.description: A commit, or a range with .. (at most 200 commits, oldest first); defaults to HEAD.

cwd.description: Absolute directory inside the repository; defaults to the calling agent session's worktree.

commands.title: Export agent session
commands.description: Write a session bundle into a new directory: session.json (the session record), log.jsonl (Clubmate's log of the session) and refs.bundle (a git bundle of the session's checkpoint refs and the notes of the commits its turns made, without commits already on a branch, remote or tag). Fails while a turn is running or when dir exists. Import it with agents.import. Returns {dir}.

dir.description: Absolute path of the directory to create.

commands.title: Import agent session
commands.description: Continue an exported session (agents.export) in this workspace: fetches its checkpoint refs and notes into the repository, adds a closed copy of the session with its transcript (importedFrom: the original id), and starts a new session (like agents.new: the caller's worktree, or a new worktree with branch) whose first prompt is a handoff brief of the copy followed by note. The copy and the new session link to each other (handoffTo, handoffFrom). Returns {session, imported, worktree}.

dir.description: Absolute path of the bundle directory.

note.description: What the new session should do next; defaults to picking up where the old one left off.

commands.title: Close agent session
commands.description: Close the session; the agent process stops when no open sessions remain in its worktree. The transcript stays readable.

commands.title: Show agent session
commands.description: Select the session in the Agents section and focus its transcript; Cron and Backlog call it to show an owner or claimer.

turn.description: Scroll the transcript to this turn (1-based) and keep it there until the session starts a new turn.

commands.title: Next agent session
commands.description: Select the session `by` rows below the selected one in the Agents sidebar (negative: above), counting only the rows shown and wrapping around, and focus its prompt; the app's Next and Previous Session run it.

by.description: Rows to move: 1 the next session, -1 the previous one.

commands.title: Delete agent session
commands.confirm: Delete this agent session, its child sessions, their transcripts and their checkpoints?
commands.description: Close the session and its child sessions (cancelling running turns), delete them in the agent when supported, and remove their logs and checkpoint refs.

commands.title: Resume agent session
commands.description: Reattach a session whose agent process is gone (session/resume); fails when the agent cannot resume. Runs in the background.

commands.title: Send review comments
commands.description: Send the open comments of a Clubmate review to a session as one Review prompt, shown as a Review card on the Mac. session is used while open; else the most recently active open session in worktree; else a new session there. Returns {session}.

session.description: Recipient session id; may be empty or closed.

note.description: Optional note added at the end.

nrev.description: Absolute path of the nrev binary the agent resolves comments with.

commands.title: Set graph runs that need you
commands.description: The graphs plugin's list of this workspace's graph runs that need you (a step waiting for approval, an edge past its round cap); agents.sessions lists each as a run entry. Only the graphs plugin may call it.

runs.description: Runs that need you: {run, title, kind (step|cap), request, node, edge?, text, command?, since}.

commands.title: Set sessions' pending reminders
commands.description: The cron plugin's list of this workspace's one-shot jobs (at, in) that prompt the session that owns them; a done session with one shows as running in agents.sessions. Only the cron plugin may call it.

commands.title: Post open items
commands.description: Leave the decisions and offers still open at the end of your turn for the user, instead of burying them in your report. The turn ends done; the user sees a quiet card under the report and answers it when they want, and that answer starts your next turn. For a question you cannot go on without, use AskUserQuestion instead. Don't repeat the items as questions at the end of the report. A decision has a header of up to 12 characters, a question, 2 to 4 options with a one-line description each (Other is always offered, don't list it) and optional multiSelect; an offer has a label and an optional description. Each item carries quote, the sentence of your report it comes from, word for word. Pass all you have: Clubmate shows 3 decisions and 4 offers and files the rest in the backlog. From a child session the items go to the session that started it. Returns {items, overflow, handed}: the ids shown, the backlog task ids of the rest, and handed when the parent got them. The user may pass session to seed items; an agent posts for its own session only.

session.description: Session id. Agents leave it out: it is their own session.

kind.description: decision: the user picks an option. offer: something you could do next.

header.description: Decision: a chip of up to 12 characters.

descriptions.description: Decision: one line per option, in the order of options.

multiSelect.description: Decision: several options may be picked.

description.description: Offer: one optional line of detail.

quote.description: The sentence of your report this item comes from, word for word.

commands.title: Answer open items
commands.description: Answer a session's open items and start one turn with them, queued when a turn runs. An agent gets an error. On a closed session offers start a new session in its worktree (the main checkout when that is gone; returns {session}) and decisions go to the backlog.

options.description: The picked labels of a multiSelect decision.

offers.description: Ids of the offers to do.

commands.title: Keep open items for later
commands.description: Keep a session's open items open and fold their cards to one line (later in the transcript entry). An agent gets an error.

commands.title: Move open items to the backlog
commands.description: File open items in the backlog, one task per item, and return {tasks}. An agent gets an error.

items.description: Item ids; all open items when empty.

commands.title: Say no to open items
commands.description: Close open items. No turn starts; the session's next turn begins with "None of these: …". An agent gets an error.

items.description: Item ids; all open items when empty.

commands.title: List open items
commands.description: The open items across a workspace's sessions, oldest first: [{session, title, worktree, updatedAt, items}]. An agent gets an error.

workspace.description: Workspace id; the current one when empty.

commands.title: Turn prose into open items
commands.description: Prompt a session to post what it left in prose with agents_open_items. An agent gets an error.

commands.title: Mark agent session reviewed
commands.description: Mark a session in review (Finish not merge, its turn done with changes) as reviewed: it becomes done and Clubmate may close it an hour later.

commands.title: Default finish mode
commands.description: Get the finish mode new sessions start with, or set it when value is given: ask (ask before merging) or merge (merge into main and clean up once tests pass).

value.description: New default; omit to read the current one.

commands.title: Stop worktree agents
commands.description: Close every agent session whose worktree is inside the given path, stop their agent processes and delete their checkpoint refs; handles git.worktree.vacating before a worktree is removed.

commands.title: List agent sessions
commands.description: List the workspace's agent sessions: [{id, workspace, worktree, agent, agentSessionId, parentSession?, advisor?, fork?, run?: {id, title, after?: [{role, on, outcome?}]}, title, titleSet?, status, mode, finish?, createdAt, updatedAt, closed, error?, pending?, pendingSummary?: {kind, text, tool?, at}, turnStartedAt?, asks, question?, needsYou}]. asks is true when the turn is done and the agent's last message ends with "?": it is asking a question; question is that question. needsYou is true when the session waits for the user: a permission or question is pending, or a top-level session asks; a child session's asks and its pending questions are for the session that started it (asksParent, while that session is open), only its permissions need the user; every client shows exactly these as needing you. pendingSummary says what the session waits for: kind permission (text the pending command or tool title, tool its ACP kind) or question (text the question). parentSession is the agent session that started it with agents.new; run is the agent graph run it is a node of. status is running, waiting (a permission is pending; pending lists the request ids), done, idle, error or closed. Non-destructive.

session.description: Only this session: the list holds it alone, or is empty when the workspace has no such session.

since.description: Returns {sessions, removed, cursor, delta?} instead of the list. Pass "" for every session and a cursor; pass an earlier result's cursor for only the sessions that changed since then (delta true) and the ids of the ones removed since then. A cursor from before the plugin restarted is ignored and every session comes back without delta.

commands.title: Search agent sessions
commands.description: Search the workspace's agent sessions, closed ones included, by title and by the text of the conversation (the user's prompts and the agent's replies; not thoughts or tool output). Case-insensitive substring match of the whole query. Returns at most 50 sessions, the ones whose title matches first, then the most recently updated: [{session, title, status, worktree, parentSession?, updatedAt, hits: [{kind, turn?, snippet}]}]; kind is title, prompt or reply, turn the turn of a prompt or reply, snippet a line around the match; at most 3 hits per session. Non-destructive.

query.description: Text to look for; empty returns no sessions.

commands.title: Wait for agent sessions
commands.description: Wait, without polling, for any of the listed agent sessions of the workspace to stop running. Pass only sessions you are still waiting on: one that is already done or waiting makes every call return at once. Returns at once if one of them is not running; otherwise on the first status change or new turn of any of them, or after timeout seconds with all still running (then call it again to keep waiting). Also returns early when the user sent you a message that is waiting in your queue. Returns {sessions, message?}: sessions is, in the order given, [{session, status, turn, stopReason?, error?, asks, permission?: {request, title, kind, options: [{optionId, name, kind}]}, elicitation?: {request, mode, message, url?, fields}}]; message {text, attachments?} is the user's queued message to you, removed from the queue so you get it only here: read it and act on it before waiting again. status is running, waiting (a permission or a question is pending: answer your own children's with agents.permission {session, request, option: an optionId} or agents.elicitation {session, request, action, answers}), done, idle, error or closed. asks is true when the turn is done and the agent's last message ends with "?": it is asking a question; answer a child yourself with agents.prompt, or relay the user's own answer with agents.answer. Toward the user, report only the children's questions that need the user's answer; the sidebar shows their status. Non-destructive.

sessions.description: Session ids to wait for, at least one.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait at most; default 120, capped at 300.

commands.title: Agent session transcript
commands.description: Read a session's transcript from Clubmate's own log: {session, modes, configOptions, commands, turns:[{turn, checkpointSha, stopReason, commits}], entries:[{kind, id, turn, at?, ...}], cursor, delta?}. kind is user, agent, thought, tool, plan, permission, elicitation or notice. at is when the entry began (RFC 3339); a permission or elicitation entry also has answeredAt once answered. To read what a session did in its latest turn, pass last=true and compact=true. Non-destructive.

fromTurn.description: First turn to include; defaults to all.

last.description: Only the last turn's entry in turns and its entries; modes, configOptions and commands are null.

compact.description: Drop the images in tool calls' content, the image data in user prompts, and commands (null).

since.description: A cursor from an earlier result: entries holds only the entries added or changed since then, in log order, and delta is true; fromTurn is ignored. A cursor from before the plugin restarted is ignored and the full transcript comes back without delta.

commands.title: Agent image
commands.description: An image an agent message of the session names (an images entry of agents.transcript), for clients that can't read the Mac's files. Returns {mimeType, data} with data base64; fails for any other path and for files over 8 MiB. Non-destructive.

session.description: Session whose agent message names the image.

path.description: Absolute path, as in the entry's images.

commands.title: Agent docs
commands.description: Docs (.md, .markdown, .mmd, .html, .htm) agent sessions wrote: the paths of transcript entries with doc, also from their subagents. Returns {docs:[{path, session, at}]}, one per path at its latest at (RFC 3339), newest first. Non-destructive.

session.description: Only this session's docs; omit for every session of the workspace.

commands.title: Agent blame
commands.description: Which agent session, turn and prompt made a commit or a file's lines. At the end of each turn Clubmate notes the commits the turn added to the current branch (not reachable from any other branch) in git notes refs/notes/clubmate (git log --notes=clubmate shows them). With path: git blame of the file, returns the line ranges whose commit has a note. With commit: that commit's note, or none. Returns {attributions:[{commit, startLine?, endLine?, session, turn, agent, title, prompt, checkpoint}]}. Non-destructive.

path.description: File, absolute or relative to cwd.

commit.description: Commit (any revision) instead of a file.

cwd.description: Absolute directory for a relative path or a commit; defaults to the calling agent session's worktree.

startLine.description: First line to blame, 1-based; defaults to the whole file.

endLine.description: Last line to blame; defaults to the end of the file.

startLine.description: First line of the range (path only).

endLine.description: Last line of the range (path only).

prompt.description: First line of the turn's prompt.
